import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
dogs_zurich = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Prepare data for visualization: Count of dogs by breed and district
breed_district_count = dogs_zurich.groupby(['Rasse1Text', 'KreisLang']).size().reset_index(name='Dog Count')

# Create a pivot table for visualization
pivot_table = breed_district_count.pivot('Rasse1Text', 'KreisLang', 'Dog Count').fillna(0)

# Plotting
plt.figure(figsize=(15, 10))
sns.heatmap(pivot_table, cmap='viridis', linecolor='white', linewidths=0.1, cbar_kws={'label': 'Number of Dogs'})

# Add labels and title
plt.title('Number of Registered Dogs by Breed and District in Zurich', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('District', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Dog Breed', fontsize=12)

# Rotate x-axis labels for better readability
plt.xticks(rotation=45, ha='right')

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
dogs_zurich = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Prepare data for visualization: Count of dogs by breed and district
breed_district_count = dogs_zurich.groupby(['Rasse1Text', 'KreisLang']).size().reset_index(name='Dog Count')

# Create a pivot table for visualization
pivot_table = breed_district_count.pivot('Rasse1Text', 'KreisLang', 'Dog Count').fillna(0)

# Plotting
plt.figure(figsize=(15, 10))
sns.heatmap(pivot_table, cmap='viridis', linecolor='white', linewidths=0.1, cbar_kws={'label': 'Number of Dogs'})

# Add labels and title
plt.title('Number of Registered Dogs by Breed and District in Zurich', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('District', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Dog Breed', fontsize=12)

# Rotate x-axis labels for better readability
plt.xticks(rotation=45, ha='right')
